title: Hycraft

body:
Este Modpack intenta recrear visualmente a Hytale, no busca jugarse igual, sigue siendo Minecraft, pero más bonito.

This Modpack attempts to visually recreate Hytale, it doesn't aim to play the same way, it's still Minecraft, but prettier.
